'''Naraa Chimu''' was a [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]-for-hire.<ref name="Lords" />

==Behind the scenes==
Naraa Chimu is quoted in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a part of the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Lords" />
